issues.region: right panel / active row 2 (Central Africa) subtitle
issues.problem: 'Fires · playing now' is muted olive-grey (~#5f6b4a, regular weight) in the reference; the build renders it near-black and visibly heavier, so it competes with the title.
issues.fix: On the active row subtitle use the muted colour (approx rgba(26,31,22,0.6)) and font-weight 400, not the primary ink colour.

issues.problem: 'Fires · played' is dark ink (~#1b1f1a) in the reference; the build renders it light grey (~#6f6f6a). Looks like the played/active subtitle colours are swapped.
issues.fix: Played-row subtitle: color = primary ink (#1b1f1a-ish), opacity 1. Keep the grey only for the upcoming row 3.

issues.problem: Reference has a clearly visible ~1.5-2px dark ink outline (#1b1f1a) around the lime card; the build's outline is ~1px and lighter, barely visible on the left/top edges. Content in the reference also sits ~1px further right (handle x 1117 vs 1116, title x 1178 vs 1177), consistent with the thicker border.
issues.fix: border: 2px solid #1b1f1a on the active card (or box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #1b1f1a) and keep inner padding so content shifts 1px right.

issues.problem: Reference lime fill is nearly opaque and flat (~#c5dc6e); the build is more translucent, with the map showing through as a lighter glossy patch on the right half.
issues.fix: Raise the active card background alpha to ~0.95 (e.g. rgba(200,224,110,0.95)) or drop the gradient/backdrop highlight.

issues.problem: From row 2 down everything sits 1px higher in the build, growing to ~2px at the bottom: row 2 top 162 vs 161, row 3 top 232 vs 231, Add place/Share bottom 346 vs 344. Row 1 is aligned.
issues.fix: Add 1px to the gap after row 1 (gap 9px -> 10px or match Figma auto-layout spacing) and make the Add place / Share buttons 44px tall instead of ~43px.

issues.problem: Arrows are smaller and dimmer in the build: ~9px wide vs ~11.5px in the reference, and lower opacity; left arrow starts at x 1384 vs 1386.
issues.fix: Increase arrow font-size/icon width to ~12px, color #fff at ~0.9 opacity, and nudge the left arrow 1-2px right (gap ~11px between arrows).

issues.problem: Bars after the selected year are a more saturated olive-green with higher opacity in the reference; the build's are paler and more washed out against the ice. The '2019' readout is also 1px right (1330 vs 1329).
issues.fix: Future bars: background rgba(140,160,70,0.75)-ish instead of the current lighter/lower-alpha lime; check opacity is ~0.7-0.75 rather than ~0.5.

notes: Very close build: map, pins, route, boat, player, caption and search all line up within 1px and text content is exact. Remaining defects are concentrated in the mixtape panel, where the played/active subtitle colours appear swapped, the active card lacks its heavy dark outline and opaque fill, and rows drift 1-2px upward. The year picker's arrows and future-year bars are slightly too small/pale. VOLUME label and search placeholder are 1px off, not deducted.
